newsitem.title: USA: Orphan Medical gets U.S. FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: Orphan Medical gets U.S. FDA approval.

text.p: Orphan Medical Inc said Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has given it clearance to market Elliotts B Solution.
This is the first clearance of a new drug application submitted by Orphan Medical, it added.

Elliotts B Solution is indicated as a diluent for injections into a patient's cerebrospinal fluid of methotrexate sodium and cytarabine for the prevention or treatment of meningeal leukemia or lymphocytic lymphoma.
Elliotts B Solution is comparable to cerebrospinal fluid, Orphan Medical said.

"The clearance of our first NDA (new drug application) represents a major milestone for Orphan Medical," John Bullion, chief executive, said in a statement. "We are making great progress on our other products in development and anticipate clearance of two more products by the end of 1996."
